name: ZELATO - 3.5G Black Label
description:
Zelato is an indica with a citrus-forward profile and tropical undertones, shaped by its Z and Gelato #41 cross.

STIIIZY Black Label is an exclusive flower line crafted with carefully cultivated cannabis and a focus on quality. Each batch is selected to showcase premium flower with a distinct strain-forward profile.
